title: Evaluation of an Automatic Classification Algorithm Using Convolutional Neural Networks in Oncological Positron Emission Tomography.
summary: CNN prototype PARS applied to PET/CT in research and routine cohorts; research cohort n=119; median Dice between automated suspicious ROI and manual ROI .65, ICC/volumetric comparisons and prognostic analyses reported. This is retrospective clinical imaging validation, not clinical benefit.
ai_technology: CNN performs a defined oncological PET classification/segmentation task with patient-cohort comparison; modest agreement and retrospective scope.
